## Task Completed
Enhanced `update_catalog_item` tool in `catalog_optimization.py`:

- Updated four existing tests to use 32-hex sys_ids (bypassing resolver) so they don't make real HTTP calls
- Added five new tests: empty-body guard, 404 handling, name resolution success, name not found, and resolver exception
